concept.title: How to set up a print server
concept.shortdesc: The objective of a print server is to streamline and optimize printing tasks throughout the network. The print server works as an intermediary between client computers and printers, handling print jobs and ensuring efficient print management.

ul.li: Ensure you have administrative rights on the server.
Ensure SNMP is enabled on the network.

section.title: Steps to set up a print server

ol.li: Log in to the Windows Server 2019 or 2022 with administrative credentials.
Open the 'Server Manager' from the Start menu.
In the 'Add Roles and Features Wizard', click 'Next' until you reach the 'Server Roles' page.
Select 'Print and Document Services', then click 'Next'.
Continue through the wizard, accepting the default selections, and click 'Install' to complete the installation.
Once the installation is complete, open 'Print Management' from the 'Tools' menu in 'Server Manager'.
In 'Print Management', right-click on 'Print Servers', select 'Add/Remove Servers', and add the server you are configuring.
Right-click on 'Printers' under your server, and select 'Add Printer'.
Follow the wizard to add a printer, selecting the appropriate drivers and settings for your network.
